hero.subtitle: Game Engineer & Project Lead
hero.description: I build game engines, ship polished gameplay, and lead teams to deliver. From low-level C++ optimization to Unity prototypes, I turn technical challenges into smooth player experiences. AI-augmented workflow, human-driven quality.
hero.tagline: I don't just make games. I engineer the systems that make them possible.

engine.title: SebF2DEngine
engine.description: Building a lightweight SNES-inspired 2D game engine from scratch using modern C++17. This project explores AI-augmented development workflows while creating a pixel-perfect rendering engine with custom ECS architecture, physics, and audio systems.

greenhero.title: Green Hero: Challenge Time
greenhero.description: A fast-paced mobile mini-game collection developed for the "Mon Éco Pote" association. Features short, skill-based challenges centered around eco-responsible actions. Players must quickly sort waste, pedal to charge a battery, clean solar panels, and more.

manim.title: My First Manim Animation
manim.description: Learning Manim from scratch without AI - a journey through documentation, tutorials, and hands-on experimentation.

postmortem.title: Aer Racers Post Mortem
postmortem.description: Complete analysis of the project: what went well, what went wrong, and lessons learned from leading a team of 25.

menu.title: Menu & Game Management
menu.description: State management and UI systems implementation in a custom C++ engine for Nintendo Switch.

waypoint.title: Waypoint System
waypoint.description: Calculating player positions in a racing game using dot products and waypoint interpolation.

neko.title: SIMD Quaternion Optimization
neko.description: High-performance quaternion operations using Intel Intrinsics for 3D transformations in game engines.

dreamness.title: Dreamness
dreamness.description: A mysterious 2D platformer with surreal pixel-art visuals. Features puzzle mechanics like character duplication and spatial shifts.

13th_hour.title: The 13th Hour
13th_hour.description: A survival horror experience. Explore an abandoned building, prepare an exorcism, and survive when the ghost awakens at the Thirteenth Hour.

forgoten_hero.title: Forgoten Hero
forgoten_hero.description: Pete the garbage collector wakes up on a conveyor belt heading to the incinerator. Run, dodge trash, and destroy generators to survive!

gravity_punk.title: Gravity Punk
gravity_punk.description: A gravity-flipping 2D platformer in a neon cyberpunk world. You're Test Subject G-13, armed with gravity-shifting shoes to survive deadly trials.

aer_racers.title: Aer Racers
aer_racers.description: A Ghibli-inspired multiplayer pod racing game for Nintendo Switch using a custom C++ engine. Led a team of 25 as Project Manager, Designer, and Gameplay Programmer.

bachelor.title: Bachelor Thesis: Biofeedback in Horror Games
bachelor.description: Analyzed how players' pulse data can dynamically influence gameplay in VR horror. Built a custom Unity experience with real-time biometric integration.

neko.title: Neko Engine
neko.description: Contributed to a custom 3D game engine (SDL2 + OpenGL ES 3.0) targeting Desktop, WebGL2, and Nintendo Switch. Developed various optimization tools.

networking.title: Networking FPS
networking.description: Built a multiplayer FPS with Photon PUN. Implemented UDP networking, player sync, lag compensation, and networked game state management.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Games Programming
education.description: Comprehensive training in game development covering engine architecture, graphics programming, multiplayer systems, and gameplay implementation.

eco_pote.title: Gameplay Programmer & Project Lead
eco_pote.description: Leading development of educational games promoting eco-friendly habits. Managing a team of 3-4 people, integrating artists into the pipeline, and developing mini-games inspired by Dumb Ways to Die.

unige.title: Developer
unige.description: Versatile developer at the Data Analytics Lab (Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences). Creating math animations with Manim for MOOCs, developing an AI chatbot for statistics questions (OpenAI API, Node.js), and contributing to the student web platform (Quarto, R).

lausanne.title: Full-Stack Web Developer
lausanne.description: Developed a web application using React.js, PHP, and modern web technologies. Built interfaces, implemented features, and managed server-side logic.

athena.title: Developer
athena.description: Web application development and extensive testing with R Studio. Combined technical implementation with data analysis and team support.

youtube.title: YouTube Channel Manager
youtube.description: Managed a monetized channel with focus on audience engagement and trend analysis. Created thumbnails, optimized content, and analyzed performance metrics.
